newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia money market down 10 bps to 11.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatia money market down 10 bps to 11.7 pct.

text.p: Croatia's average money market rate dropped 10 basis points to 11.7 percent on Thursday in extremely slow trade.
Settlements totalled a meagre 9.5 million kuna amid very low demand and were outstripped by funds on offer by some six times.
The weighted rate for interbank call money which accounted for nearly half of today's trade remained unchanged at 10.6 percent.
Term loans were struck at between 14 and 16 percent.
Insurers rolled over six million kuna at an unchanged rate of 9.0 percent for one-week funds and 18 percent for one-month loans.
The central bank calculated the kuna midrates for Thursday firmer at 5.9727 against the dollar and 3.5741 against the mark. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
